title: Luscious Lacquer-Glazed Kenyan Lamb Bowl
description: A tangy and tender Kenyan-inspired dish featuring lamb, sansho peppers, and a sweet lacquer glaze. This halal-friendly meal is perfect for meal prep and served in an earthenware bowl.
instructions: Season the lamb shoulder with salt and black pepper.
Heat the coconut oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, then set aside.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the sansho peppers and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Return the lamb shoulder to the pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and cook for 2 hours.
While the lamb is cooking, prepare the lacquer glaze by whisking together the lacquer glaze and lime juice in a small bowl.
After 2 hours, remove the pot from the oven and brush the lacquer glaze over the lamb shoulder.
Return the pot to the oven and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Let the lamb rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve in an earthenware bowl.
